title: Moby Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: Ishmael joins a whaling voyage driven by Captain Ahab’s consuming obsession.

longDescription: Movement, unfamiliar places and difficult choices carry the reading experience forward. Alongside the excitement, the story asks what loyalty, resourcefulness and courage look like under pressure. Its historical setting also reflects the assumptions of its period, which modern readers may wish to consider critically.

authorInfo.bio: Herman Melville was an American writer of the American Renaissance period. Among his best-known works are Moby-Dick (1851), Typee (1846), a romanticized account of his experiences in Polynesia, and Billy Budd, Sailor, a posthumously published novella. At the time of his death, Melville was not well known to the public, but 1919, the centennial of his birth, was the starting point of a Melville revival.
